checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Realistic wooden cabin among pines at dawn
must.why: Weathered log cabin, pine forest, pink dawn glow and mist.

must.item: Camera advances smoothly toward front door throughout
must.why: Cabin grows steadily larger and door is centered across frames; smoothness inferred from stills.

must.item: Foreground trees shift relative to cabin conveying forward movement
must.why: Trunks move outward and past the frame edges as the cabin enlarges.

must.item: Consistent shapes, no cuts or scene changes
must.why: Cabin and trees stay consistent across frames, consistent with one continuous shot.
Frames are 16:9; the clip is stated as silent.

faults.what: Cabin has no visible windows and the side porch is slightly vague.
The foreground trunk in the last frame is slightly soft, a common AI-video trait.

summary: A realistic misty dawn cabin among pines with a steady push-in toward the door and foreground trunks sliding past, matching the brief with only minor softness.
